project.name: Sylphx Skills
project.summary: Industry-aligned Agent Skills catalog and install adapters for Codex, Claude Code, and Grok Build.

goals: Ship a semantic catalog of specialized requestable job skills with progressive references.
Keep always-on floors thin and miss-class-A only.
Install and sync skills for Codex, Claude Code, and Grok Build from exact source revisions.
Enforce one quality vocabulary (Quality North Star) and one owner path per constraint pack.
nonGoals: Own live work or organization-wide adoption state.
Publish a policy encyclopedia as top-level listing skills.
Preserve obsolete listing-standard paths, methods bags, or dual-authority prose.
Hard-cap listing count for appearance; organize by requestable-job semantics only.

delivery.terminal: default-branch tree passes npm test; catalog digests match packages; constraint packs resolve only under applying skills; no dead listing-standard URLs in active skills
